description: This file defines PlayerActivity, a Kotlin class that manages a full-screen media player using ExoPlayer within an Android application. It handles media playback initialization, UI controls including custom animations for controls, immersive full-screen mode, and lifecycle management for media playback.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An Activity that provides an immersive, full-screen video player interface using ExoPlayer, with custom control animations and lifecycle handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, reads intent extras, sets up views, and configures immersive mode and control animations.

methods.name: wireControllerButtons
methods.description: Binds event listeners to custom control buttons such as settings and fullscreen/close.

methods.name: attachControllerListenersIfPresent
methods.description: Finds control buttons within the player view and sets click listeners.

methods.name: setupUnifiedControllerAnimations
methods.description: Sets up a synchronized animation for the visibility transitions of media control UI group.

methods.name: animateControllerGroup
methods.description: Performs animated show/hide of the controls group with consistent easing and timing.

methods.name: initializePlayer
methods.description: Creates and prepares the ExoPlayer instance with media URL, and manages poster visibility.

methods.name: enterImmersiveMode
methods.description: Configures the activity to run in immersive full-screen mode.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method; initializes player on SDK 24+.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Lifecycle method; re-initializes player on SDK <24 and restores immersive mode.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Lifecycle method; releases player on SDK <24 and disables immersive mode.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Lifecycle method; releases player on SDK 24+.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Releases player resources and exits the activity.
